lastCompletedStory.title: Durable stalled escalation: merge-watch-stalled event + marker, consumed on merge

nextStoryContext: US-002 (durable stalled escalation) is done: added 'merge-watch-stalled' to WorkerEventKind + a typed MergeWatchStalledEventDetail (prNumber, reason, optional prUrl/issueId) in src/supervisor/events.ts. src/release/merge-watch.ts gained SHIP_STALLED_FILENAME ('.cam-ship-stalled.json') + never-throw readShipStalledMarker/writeShipStalledMarker/removeShipStalledMarker helpers (mirroring the merge-watch state I/O helpers), a pure emitStalledEvent() helper called from every non-merged terminal site (handleBehindStatus's give-up branch -> 'behind-unrecovered', handleBlockedStatus's ci-red branch -> 'ci-red', processPollResult's closed/dirty branches -> 'closed-not-merged'/'dirty', and stepMergeWatch's timeout branch -> 'timeout'; MERGED never emits it), and MergeWatchOutcome's non-merged variants now carry an optional `prUrl` field (sourced from the same PrStatus.url already threaded in US-001) so the caller does not need a second gh poll. src/commands/sidecar.ts gained an exported updateShipStalledMarker(markerPath, outcome, state) helper wired into makeProductionMergeWatchFn's terminal else-branch (right after removeMergeWatchState): on 'merged' it removes the ship-stalled marker ONLY when the existing marker's prNumber matches state.prNumber (a marker for a different PR is left intact); on any non-merged terminal it writes/refreshes the marker with prUrl/issueId defaulting to null when unknown. US-003 (orchestrator boot surfaces the ship-stalled marker) is next -- it will likely read .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json at orchestrator boot (mirroring the ORCH_READY_MARKER / .cam-orch-session boot-read pattern in run.ts) and narrate/print it so a recycled orchestrator learns about a stalled ship even when the pane scrollback with the live notifyOrchestrator narration is gone. The marker is NOT consumed by a boot-read (only consumed by a later MERGED terminal for the same prNumber, per US-002's design), so US-003's boot-read must be read-only (do not delete the marker just because the orchestrator restarted and saw it once).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal harness change (WorkerEventKind union, node:fs-backed marker I/O helpers mirroring existing durable-state patterns, sidecar terminal-branch wiring); no new external library surface introduced beyond gh CLI fields and node:fs APIs already validated in US-001/prior stories.
